verdict.rationale: Lorikeet claims analytics that track resolution quality, customer satisfaction, revenue impact and operational efficiency (docs-23). It also mentions conversational insights and analytics from Coach (docs-30) and guardrail events landing in analytics as tracked outcomes (docs-36). That roughly covers resolution and CSAT, but only as one-line marketing claims, with no detail on the dashboards or metric definitions. Missing for 10: explicit handoff/escalation-rate metric, cost-per-resolution metric, documented dashboard views or exec-ready reporting/export, independent or hands-on corroboration.
